name: CARBOplatin + PACLitaxel (NSCLC)
histology: any NSCLC histology (squamous and non-squamous); carboplatin/paclitaxel is a histology-agnostic platinum doublet

biomarkers.note: Cytotoxic carboplatin/paclitaxel doublet is not biomarker-restricted and is used across NSCLC histologies. For first-line use it is for NSCLC without an actionable oncogenic driver: driver-positive disease (EGFR/ALK/ROS1/etc.) is directed to targeted therapy. Broad molecular profiling and PD-L1 testing recommended before first-line therapy. Per Standard Guidelines (NCCN), Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer, NSCL-E and NSCL-F.

lineOfTherapy: first-line for metastatic NSCLC without an actionable driver (and a standard subsequent-line cytotoxic option after single-agent immunotherapy); also used as a perioperative option and as the chemotherapy backbone with concurrent thoracic radiation; not line-scoped in the perioperative setting

eligibilityCriteria.requirement: option for patients who are not candidates for cisplatin-based therapy, and histology-agnostic
eligibilityCriteria.source: Standard Guidelines (NCCN), Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer
eligibilityCriteria.locator: v7.2026, NSCL-E, Useful in Certain Circumstances: Carboplatin/Paclitaxel

eligibilityCriteria.requirement: no actionable oncogenic driver in the first-line setting; driver-positive disease goes to targeted therapy
eligibilityCriteria.source: Standard Guidelines (NCCN), Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer
eligibilityCriteria.locator: v7.2026, Principles of Molecular and Biomarker Analysis

drugs.name: CARBOplatin

provenance.source: Standard Guidelines (NCCN), Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer
provenance.locator: NSCL-F 1 of 2, footnote g: paclitaxel 200 mg/m2 and carboplatin AUC 6 every 21 days (line 4838)

drugs.notes: Source: Standard Guidelines (NCCN) v7.2026, NSCL-F footnote g line 4838 (carboplatin AUC 6 every 21 days as the carboplatin/paclitaxel doublet dose). Target AUC dosed by Calvert formula (basis auc, unit AUC, dosePerUnit is the target AUC). ISMP tall-man (CARBOplatin).

drugs.name: PACLitaxel

provenance.source: Standard Guidelines (NCCN), Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer
provenance.locator: NSCL-F 1 of 2, footnote g: paclitaxel 200 mg/m2 and carboplatin AUC 6 every 21 days (line 4838)

drugs.notes: Source: Standard Guidelines (NCCN) v7.2026, NSCL-F footnote g line 4838 (paclitaxel 200 mg/m2 every 21 days). Requires corticosteroid + H1/H2 antihistamine premedication per paclitaxel labeling. ISMP tall-man (PACLitaxel). Note: with concurrent thoracic radiation a lower weekly schedule (carboplatin AUC 2 + paclitaxel 45 to 50 mg/m2 weekly) is used instead (NSCL-F lines 4811, 4814).

regimen.cycles: typically 4 cycles as a platinum doublet in the metastatic and perioperative settings; per clinical review

premedications.name: PACLitaxel premedication
premedications.notes: corticosteroid, H1 and H2 antihistamine premedication per paclitaxel labeling to prevent hypersensitivity.

premedications.name: Antiemetic prophylaxis
premedications.notes: carboplatin/paclitaxel is moderate emetic risk; give prophylaxis.

supportiveCare: antiemetics: moderate emetic risk; prophylaxis on day of treatment
carboplatin dosed to target AUC (Calvert formula) using measured or estimated GFR

monitoring: CBC before each cycle - carboplatin thrombocytopenia and neutropenia
peripheral neuropathy assessment before each cycle - paclitaxel
renal function (GFR) before each cycle (drives AUC dosing)

doseModificationRules.text: Review required. Hold or reduce per protocol-specific hematologic criteria; physician decides.
Reduce or hold paclitaxel per neuropathy grade; clinical review.

core.source: DeVita, Hellman, and Rosenberg's Cancer: Principles & Practice of Oncology, 12th ed.
core.locator: Chapter 30, Non-small-cell Lung Cancer: carboplatin plus paclitaxel is a commonly used histology-agnostic platinum doublet, including with thoracic radiation (line 68901; concurrent weekly carboplatin AUC 2 + paclitaxel 45 mg/m2, line 68915)

guideline.source: Standard Guidelines (NCCN), Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer
guideline.locator: NSCL-F 1 of 2, footnote g (paclitaxel 200 mg/m2 + carboplatin AUC 6 every 21 days, line 4838); NSCL-E (Useful in Certain Circumstances: Carboplatin/Paclitaxel, any histology)

provenanceNote: ONCQIS Standard Protocol draft for the carboplatin plus paclitaxel doublet in NSCLC (histology-agnostic). Doses are grounded: CARBOplatin AUC 6 Day 1 (basis auc, unit AUC, dosePerUnit is the target AUC) and PACLitaxel 200 mg/m2 Day 1 every 21 days per Standard Guidelines (NCCN) v7.2026, NSCL-F footnote g line 4838, which prints the carboplatin/paclitaxel doublet dose. For first-line use this is for NSCLC without an actionable oncogenic driver; it is also a standard subsequent-line cytotoxic option after single-agent immunotherapy. A lower weekly schedule (carboplatin AUC 2 + paclitaxel 45 to 50 mg/m2 weekly) applies with concurrent thoracic radiation (NSCL-F lines 4811, 4814) and is noted rather than encoded. ISMP tall-man applied (CARBOplatin, PACLitaxel). Carboplatin AUC via Calvert formula and paclitaxel hypersensitivity premedication are captured. No field is set to VERIFY. This remains a StewardMD Standard Protocol; no endorsement implied.
